question: Where is the event held and is parking available?
answer: The Abide Conference will take place at the Macon Coliseum (also known as the Centreplex) located at 200 Coliseum Drive, Macon, GA 31217. Parking is available in the lots surrounding the Macon Coliseum.

question: Are there hotel accommodations nearby?
answer:
Yes. There are several hotels located within a short driving distance of the Macon Coliseum. We encourage those traveling from out of town to reserve their accommodations as early as possible.

We've partnered with nearby hotels to make your stay for Women in Truth: Abide 2026 simple and convenient.

[Book Your Hotel](https://app.marriott.com/reslink?id=1773160003481&key=GRP&app=resvlink)

question: Is the venue wheelchair accessible?
answer: Yes, ADA/Accessible seating is located throughout the Macon Coliseum! Accessible parking is available on the north side of the parking lot, near the box office. Vehicles parked in accessible spaces must have a permit displayed. If you have questions about accessibility, please call the Box Office at 478-803-1593.

question: Can I be seated in a certain section/row/seat?
answer: All seating is on a first-come, first-serve basis. We want you and your group to have the best possible seating and suggest that you get in line as soon as possible. Doors always open no later than one hour prior to each session.

question: Are there group rates?
answer: Yes! We offer discounted ticket prices for groups of 10 and more. Discounted rates are automatically applied on the Ticketmaster website when you go to purchase tickets.

question: Do you offer church partnerships?
answer: Absolutely! We encourage groups of women to come experience Abide as a community. For church partnership opportunities email: [lacey@livingtruthco.com](mailto:lacey@livingtruthco.com)

question: What is the refund policy?
answer: All ticket purchases are final and cannot be refunded or exchanged. If you find that you're unable to attend, we encourage you to bless a friend by sharing your ticket so she can experience Abide 2026 in your place.

question: How do I find more information on corporate partnership?
answer: For more information on corporate partnership email: [info@livingtruthco.com](mailto:info@livingtruthco.com)

question: What's your bag policy?
answer:
The venue enforces a clear bag policy. Typically guests may bring one clear bag (maximum approximately 12" x 6" x 12") and one small clutch or wallet (about 8.5" x 5.5").

Other bags, backpacks, and large purses are generally not permitted.

question: Are snacks and water bottles permitted?
answer: Snacks and water bottles are not permitted in the doors. However, there are concession stands located throughout the Macon Coliseum concourses serving your favorite snacks with sodas and water also being available! All food and beverage locations inside the Macon Coliseum are cashless - only credit/debit cards and mobile payments (such as Apple Pay and Google Pay) are accepted.

question: Is childcare provided?
answer: No, childcare will not be provided during the conference. We encourage attendees to make childcare arrangements in advance. If needed, you are welcome to bring your infant with you. Please note that we will have private breastfeeding areas available at the venue. Because the conference will include live worship and music, the sound levels may be loud for little ears. If you plan to bring your baby, we recommend bringing infant ear protection for their comfort.

question: Is there an age requirement to attend?
answer: The event is appropriate for teenage girls and adult women. We are encouraging moms to consider bringing their teenage daughters to experience the event together.
